home.eyebrow: For the places you return to
home.title: A clearer reason to come back.
home.body: njiw. gives regulars a warm, simple way to follow their favourite cafés—while the café keeps control of every staff-confirmed loyalty moment.
home.announcement: A calmer rhythm for regulars and cafés.
home.footerBrand: njiw. / نجيو · a working brand concept
home.footerNotice: Design foundation only · no production data
home.previewTitle: A little more reason to come back.
home.previewBody: Your progress will live here once your café and membership are connected.
home.previewSlots: Six simple steps. One clear reward.

marketing.howTitle: A clearer rhythm for regulars and cafés.
marketing.howBody: njiw. is designed around a simple promise: customers see their progress clearly, while cafés keep control of the staff-confirmed loyalty workflow.
marketing.customerBody: Use a mobile web page to understand a café’s program, view progress, and present a membership credential when a later connected experience is available.
marketing.cafeBody: Create a clear program and give staff an explicit, recoverable workflow. njiw. does not process customer payments.
marketing.privacyTitle: Trust is part of the product
marketing.privacyBody: The foundation keeps customer, business, and platform concerns separate. No action on these pages confirms a purchase or creates a reward.
marketing.contactTitle: We will make the next step clear.
marketing.contactBody: Support and onboarding channels will connect in a later phase. For now this is an honest structural shell, not a submitted support request.
marketing.contactUnavailable: Support contact is not connected yet.

customer.title: Your café relationship, in one clear place.
customer.description: A phone-first shell for membership, progress, rewards, and help. It is not connected to an account or loyalty balance.
customer.progressUnavailable: Progress will appear here after a real membership and server connection exist.
customer.credentialBody: A future credential will identify your membership for an authorized staff workflow. It is not a payment and this preview does not generate a QR code.
customer.rewardBody: Reward terms and progress will be shown from the published program version.
customer.notEnrolledBody: Join or recover a café membership in a later connected phase.
customer.rewardsBody: Available, pending, used, and expired benefits will be separated clearly.
customer.activityBody: Confirmed, pending, rejected, and corrected events will be distinguishable here.
customer.accountBody: Language, optional contact purposes, consent, export, and deletion requests will live here.
customer.notConnected: This customer area is not connected yet.

staff.title: A focused counter workflow.
staff.description: A visual shell for branch context, credential review, and explicit server results. Camera access and transactions are not active.
staff.branchUnavailable: Assigned branch context will come from a secure session.
staff.scannerBody: The camera viewport belongs here later. This preview never requests camera permission.
staff.manualBody: An accessible fallback can be provided when a camera or compatible device is unavailable.
staff.recentBody: Server-confirmed results and safe retry guidance will appear here.
staff.exceptionsBody: Corrections and manual exceptions require reason, permission, and audit context.
staff.unsupported: This device cannot use the camera workflow
staff.offline: The server is unavailable. No earning or redemption is confirmed.
staff.notConnected: Staff actions are not connected yet.

merchant.title: Operations without dashboard noise.
merchant.description: A responsive shell for business setup, programs, branches, staff, activity, and billing records. No tenant data is loaded.
merchant.setupBody: Business, branch, staff, brand, and program setup will be guided here.
merchant.programsBody: Draft, published, scheduled, and retired program versions will be separated.
merchant.activityBody: Connected reporting will describe authorized loyalty events, not total sales.
merchant.teamBody: Assignments and permissions will be branch-scoped.
merchant.billingBody: TND invoices and manually verified payment evidence will use explicit states.
merchant.notConnected: Merchant operations are not connected yet.

admin.title: Clarity for sensitive operations.
admin.description: A distinct operational shell for controlled onboarding, support, subscriptions, incidents, and audit context. No admin authority is present.
admin.queueBody: Approved workflows will show evidence and reasoned outcomes.
admin.merchantsBody: Merchant records will be scoped and access-sensitive.
admin.subscriptionsBody: TND subscription records and manual payment evidence will be reviewed here.
admin.supportBody: Every action will preserve an audit trail and affected-party context.
admin.auditBody: Immutable records will be reviewed through controlled permissions.
admin.notConnected: Platform operations are not connected yet.
